metadata.title: Week 6 Summary: RNNs for Raman Spectroscopy

beats.narration_text: Hola, this is Hrishikesh. In Week six, we tested whether Raman spectra can be effectively modeled as sequential time-series data using Recurrent Neural Networks.

props.command: summarize the Week 6 RNN architecture and experimental results for Raman spectroscopy.

beats.narration_text: We hypothesized that an RNN could capture sequential dependencies across the one thousand wavenumbers. But over such long sequences, vanishing gradients cause catastrophic forgetting of early spectral peaks.

props.text:
Hypothesis:
Raman spectra act like time series.
Across long sequences,
RNNs retain early peak context.
Wait: vanishing gradients cause
catastrophic forgetting.

beats.narration_text: Here is our PyTorch implementation. We built RamanLSTM using a two-layer bidirectional LSTM with a hidden size of 128, concatenating forward and backward hidden states before a thirty-class linear projection.

props.code:
class RamanLSTM(nn.Module):
  def __init__(self, hidden_size=128):
    super().__init__()
    self.lstm = nn.LSTM(1, hidden_size,
                        num_layers=2,
                        bidirectional=True)
    self.fc = nn.Linear(hidden_size * 2, 30)

beats.narration_text: When evaluated on the test set, the model suffered an average loss of 3.4012 and reached an accuracy of exactly 3.33%. Across thirty bacterial classes, one divided by thirty is 3.33%—the network performed no better than random guessing.
This failure is a highly valuable negative result for our comparative paper. Sequential models fail at 3.3%, deep ResNets overfit at 67.5%, while local spatial CNNs dominate at 85.3%.

The conclusion is decisive: Raman spectra should not be treated as sequential time-series. Peaks are localized spatial structures, meaning convolutional architectures provide the optimal inductive bias.

props.text:
Conclusion:
Are Raman spectra continuous sequences?
No: peaks are localized spatial features.
Convolutional models
provide the optimal inductive bias.

beats.narration_text: Before choosing a sequential architecture for spectral data, test whether local spatial convolutions better preserve peak geometry. Try this prompt to explore the architectural comparison. Your turn.
